facts.fact: 叙述者将近十一点才走上楼，在楼梯顶端停住认路
facts.anchor: It was nearly eleven o’clock when I crested the stairs

facts.fact: 走廊尽头那扇门上贴着纸板做的「SETH'S ROOM」标牌
facts.anchor: A cardboard sign announced in cheerful bubble letters

facts.fact: Rose 已经往左拐，叙述者跟在她身后走
facts.anchor: Rose had already turned to the left, so I followed her

facts.fact: Marilyn 正在关右边第一扇门，盯着地板装作没看见叙述者
facts.anchor: looking resolutely at the floor as she disappeared

facts.fact: 对面房门大开，Abi 坐在床沿飞快发短信
facts.anchor: I could see Abi Brooke sitting on the edge of her bed

facts.fact: Kenji 带着一身热气与沐浴露味出现在门口，浴袍与 Marilyn 同款
facts.anchor: Kenji Nakamura appeared in the same high-necked bathrobe

facts.fact: Kenji 指着主卧套间，说那桩婚姻已经够挤，让她别动心思
facts.anchor: That marriage is crowded enough as it is

facts.fact: 叙述者当着 Rose 的面，为她失去的人致哀
Rose 交代早餐在餐厅、七点开始、十一点收
facts.anchor: Breakfast is in the dining room

facts.fact: 除了痛，叙述者还从 Rose 身上感到愤怒
facts.anchor: there was another emotion I could feel radiating
